name: Growth in Reverse

sources.title: Homepage — weekly newsletter with deep growth breakdowns of creators with 50k+ subscribers; ~35,856 subscribers claimed
Sponsorships — multi-page application form starting with name/email

conditions: No free listing or directory exists — the only inbound route is a paid newsletter sponsorship
Not a launch board: the site is a creator-growth newsletter; exposure means a sponsored placement in a weekly edition
Audience is newsletter/creator-economy operators — fit depends on the product being relevant to that crowd
requirements: Sponsorship application form at /sponsor/ (multi-page; name and email on page 1 of 3)
A product relevant to newsletter creators and growth-focused operators
Sponsorship budget — pricing not published on the site
preparation: A short pitch describing the product and the value to ~35k newsletter-growth subscribers
Landing page or offer appropriate for a creator/operator audience
workflow: Open https://growthinreverse.com/sponsor/ and complete the multi-page sponsorship form
Wait for a reply with pricing, placement options, and scheduling
If terms are agreed, the sponsorship runs in a weekly Sunday edition
watchFor: This is advertising, not a directory listing — the placement expires with the edition
Newsletter positioning ('40+ hours breaking down a creator's growth') means the audience expects tactical growth content — generic product ads may underperform
Pricing and availability are negotiated per-sponsor, not published
countsAsLive: The product appears as a sponsored block inside a Growth in Reverse newsletter edition (visible in the archive at growthinreverse.com/recent/)
